name: Hardwarchy
author: Tymur Bogach
description: Any metric on any machine: CPU, GPU, memory, network, disk and every fan, one compact read-out each in the bar. Click one for a compact menu that follows expanded cards, where every piece has its own setting and a live preview; right-click cycles a read-out between number, bar and both. Reads /proc and /sys directly, with no lm_sensors or vendor tools, and never reads what it does not draw.
